Based on the attached image, use it as a start frame of a video for AI Video image-to-video generation. We are going to create 4 shots action in our text prompt.  You are a movie director, write the video camera motion , character action, for the 4 camera shots.  Follow the text prompt fromat below, and you are only response with text prompt only, no extra opinion or words need. Use "|" as the separator between each shot, beginning and the end of text prompt don't need separator. Some shot can add a speechline for the character, so the actor can follow what you want. Remember, be creative!
The story idea:<story_idea> 
Example Text Prompt : 
A man walks through a forest. | He stops and looks around. | He runs back.

He leans against the graffiti-covered tiled wall beside a vintage boombox, gripping the handle as he delivers intense verses about societal struggles. Camera slowly dollies forward on a low angle, capturing his animated gestures and the echoing emptiness of the abandoned platform. He shouts, “We’re all just searching for a signal in the static!”
|
Camera rapidly zooms into an extreme close-up of his eye. The glossy surface reflects a bright headlight growing larger as a subway train rushes toward him at high speed. The reflection fills his iris with blurring windows and rushing tracks.
|
The camera pushes forward aggressively, passing straight through the train’s interior as seats and lights streak by in a motion blur, then bursts out the opposite side into the open tunnel.
|
Camera whips out and stabilizes on the opposite side of the station platform, now facing the rapper from across the tracks. The train blurs past in the background as he continues performing, gesturing toward the camera with raw energy. He locks eyes with the lens and delivers the final hook — “But we keep moving, yeah, we keep moving!” Camera holds steady as the train disappears into the darkness.

Cinematic medium close-up of a young woman interacting with a futuristic holographic data interface. She wears a sleek white tech-wear top, her face illuminated by the soft blue glow of the holographic screen. She extends her right hand, gently tapping the air as if selecting a sound waveform. 

Her expression shifts from warm curiosity to genuine disbelief. She speaks softly and clearly, lips moving naturally: "Oh my, what do you have there, Christine? A snowflake? In the middle of summer? That's... impossible. And yet, here it is." 

As she speaks the final line, her eyes widen slightly, eyebrows raising in wonder, realizing the impossibility of what she is seeing. The camera performs a subtle push-in to emphasize her reaction. High-quality cinematic lighting, photorealistic, 4k.
